time.value: Each panel carries its own time basis; the performance response echoes its own startDate/endDate reporting period, and Done Today is computed independently of the selected date range.

grain.value: One current Dashboard snapshot per selected department/role view and applied date period; panel values are scalar observations, not entity identifiers or row-derived record counts.

caveats.value: Each Dashboard panel has its own population and time basis; counts from different panels must not be added together.
The License Distribution total is a sum of independent status buckets that may overlap, so it is not a certified count of distinct licenses.
The inspected performance pipeline is application-only; SLA Compliance and Approval Rate are not all-task or all-received-application measures.
A missing panel or field is unavailable, not zero.

filterScope.value: The displayed Dashboard view is determined by the selected department/role workspace and the applied time range; the same route can show another department or period.

time.value: Each panel has its own time basis; the returned startDate/endDate establish the actual normalized reporting period for the performance panel, and Done Today is independent of the selected range.

provenance.notice: Original TaskSpec and rejected plans are unchanged. Only scalar values matching actual Reader field hashes are restored from the separately saved browser response; this is offline evidence reconstruction, not a new business receipt. Unstructured reference passages are not reconstructed. Only the 29 requested metric scalar paths plus echoed period endpoints are rebuilt. Unrelated topServices paths are deliberately excluded; the original AR browser/Reader value differed at topServices[0].serviceNameEn and is not used as proof.
